## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link an issue, maturity
task or ADR when relevant. State the scope for experimental features.

## Validation

List commands and platforms actually tested, their results, and checks still
needed from CI or a platform maintainer. Distinguish compilation from execution.

## Compatibility and documentation

Describe any syntax, type, API, diagnostic, data-format or platform impact.
Link the updated specification/reference/example and design decision when needed.
